summary: Tested the OLL Franchise landing page (/franchise/robotics-ai-learning-center) and POST /api/franchise/enquiry end to end, plus homepage and school-page regressions. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass. They cover 422 for bad email, short name, invalid has_space, short phone, short reason and missing fields; a valid create returns ok+id; the record is in GET /api/growth-partners (admin) with interest_type=centre_franchise, source=franchise_landing, status=new, has_space and details stored, and no _id. Frontend: /franchise redirects correctly. All 18 section testids plus the footer render, with 7 skill cards and 5 steps. The 4 included tabs switch panel content. Nav, hero and steps Apply buttons scroll to the form. The mobile sticky Apply button is visible and scrolls. Form checks work: invalid phone shows a toast, missing space shows a toast, and a valid submit shows franchise-form-success. The lead appears in Admin > Growth Partners with Centre Franchise and Franchise Page badges. The classroom lightbox opens and Escape closes it. At 390px there is no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=390). Regressions pass: homepage feedback, rating card and classroom sections render; the homepage classroom lightbox works; the Techfest play button (home-tf-video-play) opens the video lightbox; the school page rb-skills shows 'Your school's first step into the future.' with 7 cards including rb-skill-drones. Test records cleaned up, including the earlier 'Test Franchise' record.

minor.issue: Franchise thank-you and alert emails go through techfest._dispatch_email, which hardcodes From 'Techfest Team <techfest@oll.co>' and Reply-To techfest@oll.co. Applicants get franchise mail branded as Techfest. Add a from/reply_to parameter or a franchise sender.
Phone is only checked for length 10-15 on the server; any characters pass, e.g. 'abcdefghij'. Add a digits regex (^[6-9]\d{9}$) on the server to match the frontend check.
Public endpoint with no rate limit or duplicate check; repeat submits create duplicate CRM leads and send repeat emails.

ui_bugs.issue: Every toast shows twice. FranchiseLandingPage.jsx line 67 mounts its own <Toaster>, and App.js line 506 already mounts a global one. Remove the page-level Toaster. RoboticsBeginnerLanding.jsx line 292 has the same pattern (existing before this change).

issues: The Apply buttons (sticky, nav, hero) scroll formRef into view, but formRef is the top of the franchise-apply section. On mobile the long intro text pushes the form card to y≈758, where the fixed sticky bar covers it. Point the scroll at the form card itself or add scroll-margin, and hide the sticky bar once the form is in view.
In the hero 'all you need is?' card, the '+' is left dangling after '1 furnished room' because the line wraps.
On first load the sticky bar overlaps the hero's 'TOTAL INVESTMENT' block.
The Techfest trailer lightbox shows the eyebrow 'CLASS FOOTAGE' and reuses the testid home-classroom-lightbox. Small labelling issue.

action_items: Remove the duplicate <Toaster> from FranchiseLandingPage.jsx; toasts currently render twice
Mobile: make Apply buttons scroll to the form card (not the section top), or offset for the sticky bar
Send franchise emails from an OLL/franchise sender instead of the hardcoded 'Techfest Team <techfest@oll.co>'
Add server-side phone digit validation to FranchiseEnquiryIn
critical_code_review_comments: routes/franchise.py reuses techfest._dispatch_email, which ties franchise mail to Techfest branding; move it to a shared email util with a sender parameter.
There is no DELETE endpoint for growth_partners. Test cleanup has to go straight to MongoDB.

Franchise leads appear under the 'Business Partner' tab (main growth_partners list), not 'Center Partner' (a separate section). This matches the agreed choice, but admins may expect them under Center Partner. Consider a filter chip for interest_type.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all functional flows pass; duplicate toast and mobile scroll-target issues)

seed_data_creation: None left behind. Deleted all growth_partners with source franchise_landing and email e1-franchise*@oll.co (2 records, including 'Test Franchise').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Classroom cards are a moving marquee: use force or a JS click on home-classroom-card-N. Admin login is at /admin/login, not /login. The pytest file cleans up its own TEST_ records through pymongo.
